description: This file defines a command handler class 'GSIMApplicationApprovalCommandHandler' in the Fineract project, which processes approval commands for GSIM accounts by invoking a service method.

classes.name: GSIMApplicationApprovalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the 'APPROVE' command for GSIM accounts, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and delegating the approval process to a dedicated service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the command to approve a GSIM application by invoking the associated service method with the command's parameters.
